description: This PHP class implements a specific purge strategy for candidate data within the OrangeHRM system, specifically deleting candidate records that have not given consent to keep their data.

classes.name: DestroyCandidatePurgeStrategy
classes.description: A class extending PurgeStrategy to delete candidate entities without consent to keep data within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Deletes candidate records associated with a specified vacancy ID if they have not consented to data retention.
